description: Six file: URIs covering both halves of the percent-encoding decision
notes: Hand-written to RFC 3986 §3.3 rather than generated by this crate's encoder, so the test is not circular. Escaped because leaving them changes what the URI means: a space, a # (which would make the rest a fragment), a literal % (which would swallow the next two bytes), a non-UTF-8 byte and a UTF-8 sequence. Left literal because they are pchar and escaping them is over-encoding: ' ( ) & , ; = + ! $ * @ : — the same set GLib's G_URI_RESERVED_CHARS_ALLOWED_IN_PATH allows, which is what g_filename_to_uri produces. Hex digits are uppercase per §2.1.
